These are notes I keep on topics in Operations Research that I found interesting,
written so that anyone can learn from them. Everything here is free to read and share
under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

**How pages are written.** Drafts are produced with the help of Claude (an AI assistant)
and then reviewed. Figures are generated from code that sits next to the text, so they can
be checked and reproduced. If you spot an error, please open an issue on GitHub.
